Shop.Vance.Refusal: Shop's closed to civilians. Clearance level 4 required. Get out.
Shop.Arden.Greeting: I assure you much is this is older than you and I combined.
Item.MagmaSauce.Name: Blaise's Magma Sauce
Item.MagmaSauce.Description: It smells like pure fire. Use with caution.
Machine.MunitionsPress.Name: Munitions Press
Machine.MunitionsPress.Desc: Compresses metal bars into ammunition using high pressure.
Item.AmberClasp.Name: The Amber Clasp
Item.AmberClasp.Desc: Fossilized resin encased in iron. A Timberline custom. An emblem of ties that bind the present in place.
SpecialOrder.Vance.Text: Perimeter Alert: localized upper sector breach detected. Looks like a swarm of {0}s. They’re digging down toward the supports. I need them cleared before they compromise the tunnel. 20 confirmed kills. Do not leave any alive.
SpecialOrder.Arden.Text: The damp is spreading. The back archive where I keep the pre-Gotoro texts has developed a structural leak. I can’t handle it alone and I don’t trust Jett’s… percussive maintenance. I need materials to shore it up. Fast.
SpecialOrder.Roxy.Text: My amp is fried. Like, sparks-and-smoke fried. Jett says I need a new battery core and copper shielding to rebuild it. Can’t afford the parts on my salary though. If you could float me the cost… I’ll owe you big time.
Jett.Intro: Whoa. Hey. Didn’t see you come in. Was busy talking to a steam valve - trying to convince it to stop making that noise…Name’s Jett. I keep the trains running. Don’t mind the black stains. Can’t get rid of em, they’re part of me now
Jett.Day.Mon: Start of the week. Same as always. Check the schedule, grease the axles. And, of course, if the 9:00 AM is delayed Elara will have my head.
Jett.Day.Tue: Funny how humans behave. Trains? Easy enough to understand. Pressure builds. Motion ensues. End of story.
Jett.Day.Wed: Twenty minutes of scrubbing didn’t do it. My hands still look like they’re covered in oil.
Jett.Day.Thu: Ever listen to a train settle? That low rumble sound? It’s like... uh... music. Heavy metal music.
Jett.Day.Fri: Big plans this weekend? Not me. I’ll probably be busy recalibrating the engine pressure gauges. Fun stuff.
Jett.Day.Sat: The platform is packed today. Tourists. I’m gonna lock myself in the workshop until they board.
Jett.Day.Sun: I should probably head to town. The workshop is quiet though and I’ve got a bunch of cracked couplers on my workbench.
Jett.Spring.General: Pollen is my nemesis. It clogs the air intakes, gums up the filters... and it makes me sneeze while I’m welding.
Jett.Spring.Mon: Everything is blooming. It’s nice I guess, but have you ever seen a freshly buffed brass bell? That’s beautiful.
Jett.Spring.Fri: Mud season. Keeps the tracks slick. Braking distance gets doubled. Gotta be careful.
Jett.Summer.General: It is way too hot in the cab today. Even the control levers are sweating.
Jett.Summer.Mon: Overheating. It kills engines and it kills my vibe. Drink water, @.
Jett.Summer.Fri: Heat expands the rails. If I’m not careful the track buckles. Such a drag, physics.
Jett.Fall.General: Leaves on the line. Sounds poetic but it turns the tracks into a slip-n-slide. Not cool.
Jett.Fall.Mon: It’s getting chilly. Steam shows better when it’s cold out. My favorite season.
Jett.Fall.Fri: Spooky season? The only thing that gives me the creeps is a hairline crack in a boiler tank.
Jett.Winter.General: My hands are so stiff I dropped my wrench in the inspection pit. Now I gotta go get it.
Jett.Winter.Mon: Frozen switches. Had to break out the blowtorch to get the tracks moving this morning.
Jett.Winter.Fri: The sound of snow is nice. Drowns out the rumble of the wheels, nice and smooth.
Jett.Hearts4.Spring: I try to be outgoing, you know? But sometimes my brain just... uh... stalls. Like a boiler losing pressure.
Jett.Hearts4.Summer: You’re easy to talk to. You don’t ask me to explain why I’m weird. I like that.
Jett.Hearts4.Fall: I fixed up an old heater for you. Uh... haven’t delivered it yet. Got nervous. But it’s ready.
Jett.Hearts4.Winter: Most people only come by to see me when there’s something wrong with the train. You come by just to hang out. It’s nice.
Jett.Hearts6.General: Hey @! Just thinking about... uh... torque specs and stuff. Definitely not your smile and eyes.
Jett.Hearts6.Rainy: I'm normally down in the pit during the rain. But I wouldn't mind you staying in here with me.
Jett.Hearts8.Spring: I'd fix anything for you, you know. Steam leak, broken axle, broken heart… wait, that was cheesy. Forget I said that.
Jett.Hearts8.Summer: It's hot in here. Here, take this water. I don't need it. I run on caffeine and fumes anyway.
Jett.Hearts8.Fall: I feel like I'm finally meshing when you're around. Does that make sense?
Jett.Hearts8.Winter: It's cold. You should stay in the shop. I'll make room on the bench. It's surprisingly comfortable.
Jett.Hearts10.Mon: I used to love machines more than people. You're the exception to my rule.
Jett.Hearts10.Fri: Thinking of closing up the depot early. Wanna go for a walk? I checked the schedule. No trains due till midnight.
Jett.Schedule.Rain.Work: The rain's making the tracks slippery. I'm staying in to work on the hydraulics.
Jett.Schedule.GreenRain: I'm keeping the doors closed. That green stuff… it ain't natural. It's gonna clog the intakes.
Jett.Schedule.Clinic.Entry: Ugh. Dr. Thorne always looks at my hands and says there’s no biological purpose for grease. He’s mistaken
Jett.Schedule.Clinic.Leave: A clean bill of health. Dr. Thorne says my lungs are 'surprisingly clear' for someone who inhales coal dust recreationally.
Jett.Schedule.BiscuitDrum: The coffee at Cassidy's is the only thing keeping this town going. Well, that and me.
Jett.Schedule.Work: Don't mind me. Just trying to figure out why this coupling won't engage.
Jett.Schedule.Buyco: This place is too clean. No soot, no grease. It's unsettling.
Jett.Schedule.Munitions: Vance has some extra blasting caps. We use them to blast rock slides on the track. Good times.
Jett.Schedule.PepperPit.Work: Blaise's machine is a steam engine that makes hot sauce. I'm just here for the release valve adjustments.
Jett.Schedule.WorkSaturday: Saturdays get busy. Tourists love the train. I just have to keep it from falling apart in front of them.
Jett.Schedule.Hiking: Sometimes you just want to hear falling water instead of grinding gears.
Jett.Schedule.NightMarket: Submarine captain has an engine frequency all his own. I come here just to hear it hum.
Jett.Location.Station: Elara runs this station like clockwork. If the 4:10 is running at 4:11, she glares at me until I apologize to the clock.
Jett.Location.Munitions: Explosives... smells like a mining job.
Jett.Marriage.Schedule.Fri: I'm heading over to Vance's to grab some blasting caps. Don't worry, I'll keep them away from the chickens.
Jett.Gift.Love: Holy sh... For me? Are you serious? This is... this is the best!$h
Jett.Gift.Like: Hey, thanks! I can definitely put this to good use on the current job.
Jett.Gift.Dislike: This can't stay in the shop. If it does and gets on a circuit board it ruins it instantly. Thanks, but... no thanks.
Jett.Gift.Hate: Get that away from the work bench! Do you have any idea how tough it is to get the sticky crap out of an intake manifold? Get that away from here.$a
Jett.Gift.Birthday: You remembered? I usually end up spending my birthday in a diesel engine. This is way cooler.$h
Jett.Gift.Gadget: No way. Is this... this is Dwarvish technology! These gear ratios are off the scale! They shouldn't even be possible! I'm going to play with this all night.$h
Jett.Gift.Battery: Yes! You know how many amps this can handle? I'm going to make my welder the happiest welder today! Thanks, @!$h
Jett.Gift.Pizza: Grease and cheese. The two most important food groups. You really know how to grease up a conversation.$h
Jett.Gift.Espresso: Fresh power just in time! I was about to slow down but now I can go for at least six more hours!
Jett.Engine: I think I just spilled oil on myself again. Thankfully it will be hard to tell old stains from new ones.
Jett.Tinkering: I hate being back at this thing. It should really be handled by someone with a steadier hand.
Jett.Coffee: I'm refilling my engines power reserves. Don’t talk to me until this cup is empty.
Jett.Washing: Damn grease is stuck under my fingernails again.
Jett.Event.2Heart.1: Come on, Betsy... build pressure. I replaced your seals. Why are you losing so much steam?
Jett.Event.2Heart.2: You're just being stubborn. Like my boss. Do I need to promise you a new paint job to get this piston working?
Jett.Event.2Heart.3: Oh! @! I... uh... I wasn't talking to the train. I was... checking the acoustics.
Jett.Event.2Heart.4: Alright, fine. I talk to them. Trains have a personality, you know? Old Betsy here is just cranky in the morning.
Jett.Event.2Heart.A1: A little, but in a good way.
Jett.Event.2Heart.R1: Heh. I'll take 'good crazy.' Better than boring.$h
Jett.Event.2Heart.R2: Exactly! If you listen carefully, you can hear the metal expanding. It tells you everything.$h
Jett.Event.2Heart.R3: Just a machine? Ouch. Don't let Betsy hear you. She might blow a gasket at you.$s
Jett.Event.4Heart.1: Ugh... too many options. 'Dark Roast', 'Blonde Roast', 'Red Eye'... I just want caffeine.
Jett.Event.4Heart.2: Hey, Jett! You holding up the line or ordering? I got a rush coming in!
Jett.Event.4Heart.3: I... uh... I need... the... uh...
Jett.Event.4Heart.4: Oh, hey @. Thank Yoba. I'm drowning here. What do I order? My brain is vaporlocked.
Jett.Event.4Heart.A1: Order for them: 'They want a black coffee.'
Jett.Event.4Heart.A2: Encourage them: 'Just take a breath. You got this.'
Jett.Event.4Heart.A3: Tease them: 'They want the Unicorn Frappuccino.'
Jett.Event.4Heart.R1: Black coffee! Yes! Simple. Efficient. Thanks, @. You saved me.
Jett.Event.4Heart.R2: Right. Breath. Intake. Compression. Exhaust. Okay. I'll have the dark roast, please.
Jett.Event.4Heart.R3: What?! No! No sprinkles! Just coffee! Oh god, everyone is looking at me.$s
Jett.Event.6Heart.1: Kinetic energy. Gravity pulling water down, just like a train coasting downhill.
Jett.Event.6Heart.2: But why does it make me feel... calm? It's inefficient. It's loud. But I can't look away.
Jett.Event.6Heart.3: Oh, hey. I come here to reset my sensors. Too much noise in the shop lately.
Jett.Event.6Heart.4: You know, engines are easy. If they break, I check the schematic. But people? There's no manual.
Jett.Event.6Heart.5: With you, though... I feel like I'm finally on the right track. No derailments. Just... smooth.
Jett.Event.8Heart.1: Come here. Hurry. You have to see this before the pressure drops.
Jett.Event.8Heart.2: I finally got the main boiler sealed. She's holding steady at 150 PSI. Listen.
Jett.Event.8Heart.3: Do you hear that? That low thrum? Thump-thump. Thump-thump.
Jett.Event.8Heart.4: Most people think machines are cold. Dead metal. But if you treat them right... they have a heartbeat.
Jett.Event.8Heart.5: Here. Put your hand on the intake valve. Right here.
Jett.Event.8Heart.7: You know... before you came to town, this garage was just... loud. Just noise. I hid in the noise.
Jett.Event.8Heart.8: But now, when I'm working, I catch myself looking at the door. Waiting for you.
Jett.Event.8Heart.9: I want you to have this. It's a gear from the first train I ever fixed. I polished the rust off. I wear it when I'm scared.
Jett.Event.8Heart.10: Now... maybe you can keep it safe for me?
Jett.Event.10Heart.1: I closed the depot early. Parked the engines. Let the boilers cool down.
Jett.Event.10Heart.2: Usually, the silence freaks me out. I need the noise to drown out my thoughts.
Jett.Event.10Heart.3: But lately, my thoughts are all just... you.
Jett.Event.10Heart.4: I'm not good at the romance stuff. I don't know flowers. I don't know poetry.
Jett.Event.10Heart.5: But I know that when you're here, my internal pressure stabilizes. Be my co-pilot? Please?
Jett.Dialogue.AcceptStardropTea: Whoa. Is this pure caffeine extract? My heart rate is preemptively spiking. I love it!$h
Jett.Dialogue.GreenRain: I locked the garage vents. If that moss gets into the intake manifold, the engine is toast. Don't touch me, I don't want spores on my overalls.
Jett.Dialogue.Dumpster: Hey! I recycle that scrap metal! Don't steal my... oh, you're looking for food? Weirdo.
Jett.Dialogue.Item.IridiumPickaxe: Whoa. Hold on. Is that... solid Iridium? The molecular density on that pickaxe must be insane. Can I hold it? Just for a second?
Jett.Dialoge.Item.BatteryPack: I can smell the ozone on you. You're carrying a Battery Pack, aren't you? My hands are itching just thinking about the voltage.
Jett.Dialogue.Item.SpaceBoots: Nice boots. Iridium-weave lining? That's standard issue for deep space mechanics. Where did you even find those?
Jett.Dialogue.Sun4: I'm calibrating this pressure valve but the needle keeps bouncing. What do you think?Jett_Valve_It's oscillating between 40 and 60 PSI...#$r 40001 10 Jett_Valve_A1#Give it a whack. (Hit it)#$r 40001 10 Jett_Valve_A2#Inspect the gasket seal.#$r 40001 -10 Jett_Valve_A3#Ignore it. It's fine.
Jett.Dialogue.Sun4.Result.Hit: Give it a whack? ...Okay. CLANG ...Huh. It stabilized. You have the touch!$h
Jett.Dialogue.Sun4.Result.Check: Inspecting the seal? Let me look... Ah, you're right. There's a micro-fissure in the rubber. Good catch.
Jett.Dialogue.Sun4.Result.Ignore: Ignore a pressure fluctuation? That's how steam boilers explode. I thought you were smart.$s
Jett.Intro.SpaceBoots: Whoa, are those... Iridium-weave Space Boots? Standard issue for deep space mechanics? That is super-cool.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort.Memory: I ordered the coconut drink. I didn't panic this time, so that’s progress.$h
Jett.Dialogue.Resort.Default: This is oppressive. The sand will ruin my gear.
Jett.CT.CommunityCenter: The Community Center is up and running. I've inspected the work. The joinery is decent, but the HVAC needs work.
Jett.CT.Joja: Joja Warehouse. Efficient supply lines and standardized inventory. No heart, but I see the logistics.
Jett.CT.Bus: You repaired the bus. I inspected the engine compartment. Pam drives it hard, but the pistons are firing properly. Well done.
Jett.CT.Boulder: The Glittering Boulder has vanished! Panning in the river is now possible. I have programmed a drone to measure ore density.
Jett.CT.MovieTheater: A movie theater? I prefer documentaries on hydraulic engineering, but I suppose fiction has its place.
Jett.CT.LuauBest: The Governor enjoyed himself. His caloric intake was adequate. Efficient cooking, farmer.
Jett.CT.LuauShorts: Why... were there undergarments in the soup? This is a biohazard. I am reporting a health code violation.
Jett.CT.LuauPoisoned: The Governor fainted! Analyzing toxin... Pufferfish? Irresponsible, but scientifically interesting.
Jett.CT.Wedding: Wow! Marriage! A legally binding contract for resource allocation and cohabitation. Congratulations on your efficiency!
Jett.CT.Divorce: Contract terminated. Emotional variance detected. If you need to smash something the junkyard’s open.
Jett.CT.BabyBoy: Male offspring. Small. Loud. Leaking fluids. Humans are messy to service.
Jett.CT.BabyGirl: Female offspring. I trust you have a sleep schedule calibrated? Lack of sleep causes operator error.
Jett.CT.PassOut: I saw Harvey drag you home. Your battery was at 0%. You’d better get a warning light next time.
Jett.Date.Spring1: Spring thaw. Moisture level rising. I need to check the gaskets on the old engines before they start to corrode.
Jett.Date.Summer1: Heat wave on the way. Metal expands in the heat. If the tracks buckle I’ll have a derailment. I’ll be busy.
Jett.Date.Birthday: My birthday? Just another timestamp. Another year of operational readiness. But…thank you for remembering.
Jett.Date.Fall1: Air intake temperature dropping. Engines run better cold. Good season.
Jett.Date.Winter1: Sub zero temps. I’ve activated the track heaters. If the switches freeze up nothing moves.
Jett.Date.EndOfYear: End of cycle. Running diagnostics... System’s nominal. Ready for another year.
Jett.Date.EggHunt: I’m skipping the hunt. Last year I found a rusted out spark plug instead of an egg. I was excited, everybody else was confused.
Jett.Dating.Mon: I used to run diagnostics every Monday. Now I just wonder when I’ll see you again. It’s... distracting.
Jett.Dating.Tue: You’re the only one who can’t make my systems crash. With you I run optimally.
Jett.Dating.Wed: I made a radio out in the garage. Want to... tune in? Pick up some signals? Music? Whatever you dig.
Jett.Dating.Thu: My hands are dirty. I’d hold your hand but I don’t want to get oil on your nice clothes.
Jett.Dating.Fri: I usually lay low on Fridays. But if you’re going out... I could probably make an exception. As long as you’re there to calibrate.
Jett.Dating.Sat: I saw a train go by and didn’t even check the wheel alignment. I was too busy looking for you.
Jett.Dating.Sun: Rest day. Wanna come over? I could show you the inner workings of an internal combustion engine. It’s romantic, I swear.
Jett.Dating10.Mon: Systems check: Heart rate elevated. Dopamine levels dangerously low. Condition: I’m head over wheels in love with you.$l
Jett.Dating10.Tue: I used to think all people were chaos variables. You? You’re a constant. My fixed point in an ever changing world.
Jett.Dating10.Wed: I’m building something new. It’s a surprise. Okay, it’s a toaster that doesn’t burn the bread but I’m making it for you.
Jett.Dating10.Thu: You make my engine run smoothly. No friction. No grinding. Just pure motion.
Jett.Dating10.Fri: I cleared my schedule. The trains can wait. The machines can wait. All I want is you.
Jett.Dating10.Sat: I’m better with engines than with words. But I’m trying to build a future that you fit into.
Jett.Dating10.Sun: Stay here? The garage is warm. The engine hum is soothing. And... I need my copilot.
Jett.Dialogue.BusFixed: I heard the bus engine turnover this morning. Rough, but it works! Good job getting it running.
Jett.Schedule.BiscuitDrum.Brave: I ordered this myself. No panic attack today. Progress.
Jett.Gift.NecklaceResponse: Is that... the gear necklace? You kept it? Looks good on you. Like it belongs there.$l
Jett.Gossip.Blaise: You’re friends with Blaise? Tell him his capsaicin fumes are eating the gaskets on his vat. I have to change them out every week. He pays in wings though, so... worth it.
Jett.Gossip.Elara: Is Elara looking this way? She measures my breaks with a stopwatch. I respect the precision but it’s terrifying. Don’t tell her I was just staring at the wall.
Jett.Gossip.Cassidy: So... you talk to Cassidy? How? She’s just so bright it’s like looking directly into a welding arc. Does she ever turn it off? It makes my sensors malfunction.
Jett.Gift.MagmaSauce: Blaise’s sauce? This stuff eats through steel piping. I use it to strip rust off of old bolts. Thanks, I was running low.
Jett.Proposal.Accept: Is this... Amber? You want to save this? Us? ...I never thought I could commit to something this complicated. But with you? Yeah, let’s do it. I’m all yours.$l
Jett.Proposal.RejectVanilla: A shell? The old sea dog down by the coast sells these. It’s nice, really... but I need something rugged. Something that can take a bit of abuse. Something that won’t break so easily.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Entering: The humidity here is going to wreak havoc on my tools. But... I guess the view is efficient.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Leaving: Back to the mainland. Back to the smog. I actually miss the smell of burning coal.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Shore: I keep expecting to find rusted gears in the sand. But it's just... shells. Nature is weirdly clean.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Umbrella: I’m calculating the UV index. It’s high. I’m staying under here until the sun re-calibrates.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Bar: I wonder if Gus can make a drink that tastes like 10W-30 motor oil? Just kidding. ...Mostly.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Towel: I’m not 'laying out'. I’m performing a horizontal structural integrity test on this towel.
Jett.Dialogue.Resort_Wander: I looked for a machine room or a generator. This island runs on... magic? It's unsettling.
Jett.Dialogue.Saloon: The noise level here is 85 decibels. It drowns out the ringing in my ears from the workshop.
Jett.Dialogue.Saloon_Fri: End of the week. Time to flush the system with hops and carbonation.
Jett.Dialogue.Saloon_Sat: Everyone is so... energetic. I’m just running on low-power mode until Monday.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring thaw. The ground is soft. Tracks shift in the mud. I have to re-align the rails every morning.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Tue: Everything is blooming. It’s pretty, sure. But pollen in a fuel filter? That’s a tragedy.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Wed: I saw a bird building a nest in the #4 exhaust pipe. I... uh... I moved the pipe. The bird can stay.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Thu: Rain again? Good. Washes the salt off the undercarriage. Nature's car wash.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Fri: My boots are covered in mud. Just warn me if I’m tracking it into the lobby, okay?
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Sat: Tourists love the flowers. I’m just making sure the flower petals don’t gum up the switch gears.
Jett.Dialogue.spring_Sun: Sunday quiet. I can hear the water rushing in the creek. Sounds like a well-oiled cooling pump.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Mon: Heat wave. I’m monitoring the expansion joints on the bridge. If the metal expands too much... snap.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Tue: It is way too hot. I’m sweating through my coveralls. I need coolant.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Wed: The air shimmer? That’s heat radiation. It messes with my optical measurements.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Thu: I put a fan in the workshop. It’s just blowing hot air around. It’s inefficient, but it feels like doing something.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Fri: Drought conditions. Sparks from the wheels could start a fire. I’m driving slower today.
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Sat: Everyone is at the beach. I’m in a metal box filled with fire. Life choices, right?
Jett.Dialogue.summer_Sun: The sun is finally going down. The metal is cooling. You can hear it 'tink-tink' as it contracts.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Mon: Crisp air. Dense oxygen. Engines run 12% more efficiently in this weather. It’s science.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Tue: Leaves on the line. It’s like driving on ice. If the wheels slip, I sand the tracks.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Wed: I love the smell of drying leaves. Reminds me of... actually, I don't know. It's just good.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Thu: Wind’s picking up. I hope the signal tower is braced properly.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Fri: Spooky spirit eve coming up? I made a costume out of cardboard boxes. I’m a robot. Original, right?
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Sat: The valley looks nice in orange. Rust color. I like rust. It shows character.
Jett.Dialogue.fall_Sun: Winter is coming. I need to winterize the depot. Drain the lines, insulate the pipes. Busy week ahead.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Mon: Cold start this morning. Engine didn't want to turn over. I had to coax it.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Tue: My hands are frozen. I can barely hold a wrench. If I drop it on my toe, I won't even feel it.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Wed: Snow dampens sound. Have you noticed? The train doesn't roar today. It whispers.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Thu: Ice on the switches. I was out there with a blowtorch at 4 AM. Glamorous lifestyle.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Fri: I’m keeping the workshop door closed. If you want to talk, come inside. Bring coffee.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Sat: I saw Vance patrolling in the snow. He looked cold. I offered him a hand warmer. He took it.
Jett.Dialogue.winter_Sun: It’s a good day to stay inside and read schematics. Or... just hang out. If you’re not busy.
Vance.Intro: Stop. ID check... Hmph. You’re the new farmer. You got your grandfather’s eyes. He always said this valley needs a keeper. Let’s see if you can handle it.
Vance.Mon: Don't touch my merchandise unless you plan to buy. I count every shell casing.{{Random: If one goes missing, I will find you.|Do not test me.}}
Vance.Tue: I saw Lewis collecting “taxes” today. You think that gold goes to the Governor? Please. It’s hush money for the Guild.
Vance.Wed: That Wizard in the tower... he’s going to bury us all. One wrong sneeze and the valley’s a crater. I’ve got a scope on his tower. Just in case.
Vance.Thu: My arm? Farming accident. That’s the story I tell people. If you want the truth... well, you don’t have the clearance.
Vance.Fri: Going to the cemetery later. Alone. Don’t follow me. It’s not a social call.
Vance.Sat: {{Random: The train brings supplies, but it brings eyes too.|I’m on the platform. Too many strangers today.}}
Vance.Sun: Civilians need rest. Sundays are for civilians. That’s when they assume we’re asleep. I use that time to calibrate the sensors.
Vance.Mon4: Report. You see anything in the lower mines? The Shadow People are getting organized. I can feel it in the tremors.
Vance.Tue4: I checked your file. You're efficient. Good. Most people here think 'danger' means a thunderstorm. They don't know what sleeps beneath the soil.
Vance.Fri4: I visit the cemetery to remember the cost of hesitation. Your grandfather... he understood that cost. He was one of the few who looked into the dark and didn't blink.
Vance.Rainy4: Rain interferes with the perimeter sensors. Keep your eyes open. If something comes out of the woods today, we won't hear it coming.
Vance.Wed8: I saw your grandfather the week before he passed. He looked... relieved. Like he was finally putting down a heavy pack. He told me, 'Vance, the valley protects its own, but only if you respect the shadows.' I still don't know if he was warning me, or saying goodbye.
Vance.Thu8: About the arm... It wasn't a rock crab. It was a Shadow Shaman. I hesitated. I tried to reason with it. It took my arm for the trouble. Don't make my mistake. When you see them... you strike.
Vance.Sun8: I'm getting tired. My reaction time is down 0.4 seconds this year. I can't hold the line forever. It's good you're here. Someone has to watch the wall when I'm gone.
Vance.Summer_Mon8: This heat... reminds me of the jungle campaigns against the Gotoro. But the green rain? That's new. That's biological warfare. I don't care what Demetrius says.
Vance.Resort.Entry: Securing the perimeter. This island is unsecured. Too many caves.
Vance.Town: Pelican Town. Soft. They have festivals while monsters spawn two miles north. It's negligence.
Vance.BusStop: This road leads to the city. To the corporation. Never turn your back to the road.
Vance.Schedule.Work: Don't loiter. Buy your ordinance and clear the area.
Vance.Schedule.Patrol: Sector 4 is clear. No sign of... them.
Vance.Schedule.Spying: I checked the shipping manifest. Three crates of 'farming supplies' that weigh twice as much as they should. Suspicious.
Vance.Schedule.Cemetery: They said it was an accident. But rock crabs don't cut brake lines.
Vance.Schedule.Bunker: The pH level in this rain is off. I'm sealing the vents.
Vance.Schedule.Hiking: Found tracks near the treeline. Bipedal. Heavy tread. Too big for a goblin, too clumsy for an elf. Something is probing the fence.
Vance.Gift.Love: Raw entropy... sealed in physical form. Good work, agent. I'll analyze this in the lab.
Vance.Gift.Like: Useful. I can rig this to the perimeter fence.
Vance.Gift.Dislike: Is this... is this bugged? Who sent you?! Take it back!
Vance.Gift.Hate: Consumer trash. This is exactly how they track your purchasing habits. Burn it.
Vance.Event.Intro.1: Hold it. One step closer and you trigger the tripwire.
Vance.Event.Intro.2: You've got that dust on your boots. Gray dust. Copper smell.
Vance.Event.Intro.3: You've been down there, haven't you? In the Mines.
Vance.Event.Intro.4: Your Grandfather... he knew the risks of digging that deep. He respected the mountain.
Vance.Event.Intro.5: Fine. If you're going to poke the hornet's nest, you'll need bigger boots. I'll open the stock.
Vance.Status.Hurt: You're bleeding. Don't bleed on the floor. Take a Life Elixir and walk it off. We don't do 'sick days' here.
Vance.Status.Exhausted: You look like you've been dragged through a trench. Sloppy. Fatigue leads to mistakes. Mistakes get you killed.
Vance.Item.Sword: That blade... balance is off. Keep the edge sharp, or it's just a glorified crowbar.
Vance.Item.Bomb: Cherry Bomb? Cute. Good for clearing rubble, but if you want to breach a wall, you need Mega Bombs. I have a crate in the back.
Vance.Item.Trash: Bio-hazard. Get that filth out of my sector.
Vance.Shop.Greeting: Ordinance available. All sales final. I'm not responsible for lost fingers.
Vance.Shop.Buy: Good choice. Fuse time is 3 seconds. Don't forget that.
Vance.Skill.CombatHigh: I saw you handling that blade earlier. Efficient. You aim for the joints. Good. Most civilians just hack away like they're chopping wood.
Vance.Skill.MiningHigh: You're going deep, aren't you? Past level 80? That's where the air gets thin. Watch your oxygen levels.
Vance.Lore.War1: The Gotoro Empire didn't use standard tactics. They used tunnellers. Came up right under the barracks. That's why I check the floorboards.
Vance.Lore.War2: People think I'm crazy for stockpiling batteries. They didn't see what happened when the grid went down in '08. Total darkness. For three months.
Vance.Schedule.Inspection: Jett's security protocols are lax. I'm just... advising. Also, the coffee machine here is superior.
Vance.Hearts8.Mon: I gave you the clearance code for the back bunker. Don't share it. Not even with Lewis.
Vance.Hearts8.Tue: I saw you handling that pickaxe earlier. Good form. Balanced stance. You'd do well in a breach team.
Vance.Hearts8.Wed: I don't usually like civilians in my perimeter. You? You're fine. You don't trigger my alarms.
Vance.Hearts8.Thu: I slept for six hours last night. A personal record. Knowing someone competent is patrolling the valley... helps.
Vance.Hearts8.Fri: If things go south, head to my shop. I have rations for two. Just in case.
Vance.Hearts8.Sat: Most people are liabilities. You're an asset. That's the highest compliment I give.
Vance.Hearts8.Sun: Rest day. Even machines need maintenance. Take a load off, Farmer.
Vance.Hearts10.Mon: I used to think I had to protect this valley alone. I was wrong. We protect it.
Vance.Hearts10.Fri: You're the only person I don't check for a wire when they walk in. Don't make me regret it.$h
Vance.Date.Spring1: Thaw confirmed. Mud makes for clear tracks. If anyone enters the valley, I'll know.
Vance.Date.Summer1: Heat wave. High risk of brush fires. Hydrate, Farmer. Heat exhaustion is a rookie mistake.
Vance.Date.Fall1: Foliage density is dropping. Visibility is improving. Good.
Vance.Date.Winter1: Snow muffles sound. Ambush conditions are ideal. Stay sharp out there.
Vance.Date.Birthday: Birthday? Irrelevant. Just means I survived another rotation. ...But the cake is acceptable.
Vance.Date.EndOfYear: Year end report: Zero breaches. Perimeter secure. Good work.
Vance.Event.4Heart.1: Hold. Pop quiz, Farmer. Situation: Three Shadow Grunts breach the north perimeter.
Vance.Event.4Heart.2: You have a rusty sword and ten seconds. What is your priority?
Vance.Event.4Heart.A1: Sound the alarm and alert the town.
Vance.Event.4Heart.R1: Correct. Information is ammunition. Heroics get you killed. Communication saves lives.
Vance.Event.4Heart.R2: Reckless. You'd be dead in four seconds. We don't need martyrs, we need soldiers.
Vance.Event.4Heart.R3: Acceptable. Containment is a valid strategy. Just make sure the barricade holds.
Vance.Event.8Heart.1: I checked the logs. That perimeter breach you cleared... efficient work. Cleaner than I could have done.
Vance.Event.8Heart.2: My reaction time... it's down another 0.2 seconds this quarter. I'm missing cues I used to catch in my sleep.
Vance.Event.8Heart.3: I used to think if I stopped watching the wall, the valley would fall. But... you're watching it too, aren't you?
Vance.Event.8Heart.4: I'm granting you Level 4 Clearance. The Bunker, the reserves... it's all open to you. If I go down... you take command.
Vance.Event.8Heart.R1: Hmph. 'Commander'. Haven't heard that in a long time. ...Good copy, Agent.
Vance.Event.8Heart.R2: Maybe not. But every soldier needs an exit strategy. You're mine.
Arden.Event.Intro.1: ...hmm. No, the patina is wrong. 1920s reproduction. Garbage.
Arden.Event.Intro.2: The shop is open. Look with your eyes, not your hands.
Arden.Event.Intro.3: Wait. You... you are the one who moved into the old farm?
Arden.Event.Intro.4: Interesting. You're covered in soil. But... I suppose digging is the only way to find buried treasure. Just wipe your feet next time.
Arden.Event.2Heart.2: There is a 400-year-old ceramic shard on the floor right next to your boot. If you step on it, history is lost forever.
Arden.Event.2Heart.A3: Ask why it's on the floor.
Arden.Event.2Heart.R1: Don't apologize. Just be aware of your surroundings. This isn't a barn.
Arden.Event.2Heart.R2: Gently! ... Oh. You handled that quite well. Most people would have crushed it.
Arden.Event.2Heart.R3: Because I was cataloging it before you barged in! Honestly.
Arden.Event.4Heart.1: 1842. 'Beloved Father'. The moss has almost taken the name.
Arden.Event.4Heart.2: Oh. I didn't see you there. I come here for the conversation. It's much better than in town.
Arden.Event.4Heart.3: The dead don't change. They don't disappoint you. They just... rest. I find that enviable.
Arden.Event.6Heart.1: Another explosion! Jett is going to shake this building apart!
Arden.Event.6Heart.2: Look at this! The vibrations are walking the Ming vase toward the edge of the shelf. I can't hold everything at once!
Arden.Event.6Heart.3: Thank you... you have steady hands. Perhaps I was wrong about farmers being clumsy.
Arden.Hearts2.Mon: I am working. Please try not to breathe too heavily on the glass.
Arden.Hearts2.Thu: You track a lot of mud in here. I spend an hour sweeping after you leave.
Arden.Hearts4.Mon: I found a fascinating treatise on ancient agriculture. Did you know they used fish bones for fertilizer? Crude, but effective.
Arden.Hearts4.Fri: You're quieter than the other tourists. I appreciate that. You may stay.
Arden.Hearts6.Mon: I was looking at this map of the valley. There should be a forgotten shrine near your farm. Have you seen it?
Arden.Hearts6.Sat: I saved a book for you. It's about the geology of the mines. I thought you might find it... useful.
Arden.Hearts8.Mon: I find myself waiting for the door chime these days. Usually, I dread it. But if it's you... I don't mind.$l
Arden.Hearts8.Sun: It's lonely in here sometimes. Surrounded by things that have been dead for centuries. It's nice to have something... living.
Arden.Hearts10.Mon: I have spent my life preserving the past. But lately, I find myself thinking about the future. Our future.$l
Arden.Hearts10.Fri: You are the rarest thing in this collection, my dear. And the only thing I cannot put a price tag on.$l
Arden.Dating.General: Hello, my love. I was just thinking about you. And dusting. But mostly thinking about you.$l
Arden.Dating.Rainy: Stay here with me. Let the rain fall. We are safe inside the archives.
Arden.Marriage.Mon: I must go to the shop today. But I will leave a note for Jett to stay away, so I can come home to you sooner.
Arden.Marriage.Fri: I watched you sleep this morning. You were so still. Like a marble statue. Beautiful.$l
Arden.Marriage.Rainy: I made tea. Green tea, imported. Drink it while it's hot, darling.
Arden.Weather.Rain: The dampness is seeping into the floorboards. I hate the rain.
Arden.Weather.GreenRain: Do not open the door! That moss... it's accelerating entropy! The statues are aging decades in minutes!
Arden.Item.ElvishJewelry: Incredible. The craftsmanship... the filigree is thinner than a human hair. Where did you find this?
Arden.Item.RareDisc: This... this shouldn't exist. The glyphs match nothing in the Gotoro archives. This is terrifying. I love it.
Arden.Item.DwarfScroll: A translation scroll? My Dwarvish is rusty, but... I believe this is a recipe. Or a declaration of war. Hard to tell.
Arden.Skill.MiningHigh: The dust on your coat... slate and limestone. Deep earth. You have been digging where the air is stale. Did you find anything... intact?
Arden.Skill.FarmingHigh: You spend your days churning the topsoil. It is necessary work, I suppose. But true history lies deeper than the plow.
Arden.Status.Filthy: Please... stand back. You smell of refuse and decay. Do not contaminate the archives.
Arden.Lore.Gunther: Gunther? Hmph. He runs a library, not a museum. He cares about completing a collection. I care about the *soul* of the object.
Arden.Lore.Museum: I heard you donated a Rare Disc to the town collection. A pity. It will sit on a cold shelf there. Here, it would have been worshipped.
Arden.Shop.Greeting: Look with your eyes. If you break it, you cannot afford to replace it.
Arden.Shop.Buy: A fine choice. Keep it out of direct sunlight.
Arden.Status.GreenRain: This moss... it is not natural. It is accelerating entropy. I watched a iron hinge rust away in ten minutes. Keep the door sealed!
Arden.Introduction: The shop is open. Look with your eyes, not your hands. If you break it, you cannot afford it.
Arden.Event.8Heart.1: No... no, no, no! The humidity level fluctuated by 3 percent!
Arden.Event.8Heart.2: Mold. Microscopic, perhaps, but it's there. Eating away at the canvas. It's all rotting, @. Everything is rotting.
Arden.Event.8Heart.3: I try so hard to keep it safe. To stop time. But I can't. Entropy always wins.
Arden.Event.8Heart.4: Why do I bother? Why save anything if it all turns to dust eventually?
Arden.Event.8Heart.A2: You can't save everything, but you can save this.
Arden.Event.8Heart.R1: Remembering... yes. Memory is the only defiance we have against time.$l
Arden.Event.8Heart.R2: You're right. I need to focus. One piece at a time. Thank you, @.$h
Arden.Event.10Heart.1: I brought you to the cemetery because... well, it's peaceful. The dead don't make demands.
Arden.Event.10Heart.2: For a long time, I preferred them to the living. The living are messy. They leave mud on the floor. They break things.
Arden.Event.10Heart.3: But you... you broke my solitude. And I haven't fixed it. I don't want to fix it.
Arden.Event.10Heart.4: I want to build a history with you. Not one recorded in books, but one we live. Together.
Arden.Schedule.Clinic.Entry: A necessary maintenance check. Dr. Thorne is efficient, at least.
Arden.Schedule.Clinic.Leave: Clean bill of health. I suppose I'm preserved for another year.
Arden.Schedule.NightMarket: The wares here are... eclectic. I'm looking for provenance, not novelty.
Arden.Schedule.Buyco: Fluorescent lights and plastic packaging. This place is the opposite of history.
Arden.Schedule.Dig: The soil here is rich with history. If you listen, the ground speaks.
Arden.Schedule.BiscuitDrum: I appreciate the acoustics here. And the tea isn't bad.
Arden.Schedule.Cemetery: They have stories that no one else remembers. I come here to listen.
Arden.Date.Spring1: New growth. Roots breaking through stone. It threatens the ruins, but... I suppose it is beautiful.
Arden.Date.Summer1: The humidity is rising. I need to check the dehumidifiers in the archive. Moisture is the enemy.
Arden.Date.Fall1: The air is crisp. Decay begins. It is the most honest season. My favorite.
Arden.Date.PreBirthday: Tomorrow marks another year. I do not celebrate aging, but I acknowledge the survival.
Arden.Date.EndOfYear: The cycle closes. We have preserved what we could. Now, we wait for the thaw.
Arden.Dating.Mon: I used to hate Mondays. They meant customers. Now, they mean I get to see you.$l
Arden.Dating.Tue: I was cataloging a vase from the Gotoro era, and I realized... I would rather be looking at you.$l
Arden.Dating.Wed: Do you need anything? I can close the shop early. The dust isn't going anywhere.
Arden.Dating.Thu: I saved a book for you. It's a first edition. I thought we could read it together.
Arden.Dating.Fri: My hands smell like old paper and lemon oil. I hope you don't mind.$l
Arden.Dating.Sat: The shop is busy, but I'm distracted. You are a very pleasant distraction.
Arden.Dating.Sun: Let's go somewhere quiet. Just us. I want to make a memory, not just preserve one.
Arden.Dating10.Mon: The past is set in stone. But when I look at you, the future feels... fluid. Exciting.
Arden.Dating10.Tue: I have spent my life guarding dead things. You make me feel alive.$l
Arden.Dating10.Wed: I used to be afraid of time passing. Of losing things. But spending time with you is worth the cost.
Arden.Dating10.Thu: You are the rarest thing in this collection, my dear. And the only thing I cannot put a price tag on.$l
Arden.Dating10.Fri: I love you. It feels strange to say it. It's not a fact I can look up in a book. But it's true.$l
Arden.Dating10.Sat: I was thinking... my apartment is small, but there is room for two. If you... never mind.$l
Arden.Dating10.Sun: Stay with me a little longer? The archives can wait.
Arden.Event.10Heart.A1: It's worth the risk. We embrace the end, so we can live now.
Arden.Event.10Heart.A2: We can stay like this. Safe. Unchanging.
Arden.Event.10Heart.R1: Embrace the end... yes. You are right. History isn't what we save in a box. It's what we make.$l
Arden.Event.10Heart.R2: Safe. Yes. Let's just... stay here. In this moment. I don't want to move forward yet.$s
Arden.Event.10Heart.Close: Stay with me tonight? The ghosts can watch themselves.
Arden.RejectProposal.Fear: I... I can't. I'm sorry. I look at that pendant and I just see something beautiful that will eventually break. I'm not ready to let you in that deep. Not yet.$s
Arden.Proposal.RejectVanilla: A shell? I believe the coastal settlements use these. It's a charming superstition, but... it's not *us*, is it? It's too... temporary.
Arden.Proposal.RejectFear: Amber... preserved forever. It's beautiful. But I... I can't accept it. We agreed to stay safe, remember? If I take this, I risk losing everything. I can't do it.$s
Arden.Proposal.Accept: Amber. A moment frozen in time... held by iron. You remembered.$l#$b#Yes. I will take it. Even if it breaks one day... having it now is worth the cost. I'm yours.
Arden.Day.Mon: Mondays are for dusting the upper shelves. The dust in this valley is 40% pine pollen and 60% regret.
Arden.Day.Tue: I am cataloging a collection of spoons from the Elemental Wars. You can tell they were used by soldiers because the handles are sharpened.
Arden.Day.Wed: It is quiet today. The wood settles on Wednesdays. I can hear the building groaning.
Arden.Day.Thu: Please do not lean on that display case. The glass is original from the Gotoro Empire. If it breaks, I cannot replace it.
Arden.Day.Fri: The weekend brings tourists. They touch things with sticky hands. I must prepare the velvet ropes.
Arden.Day.Sat: I saw Jett earlier. They offered to 'grease' my hinges. I had to physically block the door.
Arden.Day.Sun: I prefer the shop on Sundays. The light hits the stained glass just right. It feels... sacred.
Arden.Hearts2.Tue: If you find any arrowheads while tilling your soil, bring them to me. Do not clean them! You might scrub away the provenance.
Arden.Hearts2.Wed: I spend most of my time fighting entropy. Rust, mold, rot... the universe wants to destroy this room. I am just saying 'no'.
Arden.Hearts2.Fri: You are surprisingly light on your feet for a farmer. Most people stomp. I appreciate the quiet.
Arden.Hearts2.Sat: I am reading a book on ancient irrigation techniques. Your farm used to be a swamp, you know. 300 years ago.
Arden.Hearts2.Sun: I do not sell reproductions. If you want a plastic sword, go to the toy store. Everything here has a ghost attached to it.
Arden.Hearts4.Tue: Look at this map. This valley has been fought over five times in two centuries. We are walking on a battlefield.
Arden.Hearts4.Wed: I made tea. It... got cold while I was reading. You can have it if you like.
Arden.Hearts4.Thu: Gunther at the library means well, but he is a hoarder, not a curator. He puts a bone next to a crystal and calls it science. Hmph.
Arden.Hearts4.Sat: Do you ever wonder who lived in your farmhouse before your grandfather? I have the deed records. It is a tragic list.
Arden.Hearts4.Sun: I feel... calm today. Usually, the silence here presses down on me. But with you here, it just feels like peace.
Arden.Hearts6.Tue: I was looking for a specific coin, but I forgot what I was doing when you walked in. That is... inefficient.
Arden.Hearts6.Wed: My father wanted me to be a soldier. I told him I would rather save what soldiers destroy. We did not speak much after that.
Arden.Hearts6.Thu: I worry about the damp in the walls. If the archives flood... I lose my life's work. ...Why am I telling you this?
Arden.Hearts6.Fri: You have dirt on your cheek. ...No, leave it. It suits you. Like a patina on bronze.
Arden.Hearts6.Sun: I realized something today. I have spent twenty years guarding the past. I never made a plan for the present.
Arden.Hearts8.Tue: I saw a new flower blooming by the river. I almost picked it to press it in a book. Then I decided to let it live. I think you are rubbing off on me.
Arden.Hearts8.Wed: Work? No, I am not working. I am just pretending to organize papers so I can talk to you.
Arden.Hearts8.Thu: I used to be afraid of things changing. But watching you change this valley... it makes me think change might be okay.
Arden.Hearts8.Fri: I found a locket today. Empty. I kept thinking... whose picture would I put in it? ...Never mind.
Arden.Hearts8.Sat: Stay a while? The dust isn't going anywhere. But you are.
Arden.CT.cc_Complete: The Community Center... restored? I inspected the woodwork. It is not modern renovation. It is... spiritual restoration. The Junimos? Incredible.
Arden.CT.joja_Complete: The Warehouse? It is a tomb for culture. Just rows of blue boxes and fluorescent lights. It will be a very ugly ruin in a thousand years.
Arden.CT.museum_Complete: You completed the Museum collection? impressive. Perhaps Gunther is not completely incompetent. Or perhaps he just had a very good assistant.
Arden.Location.Resort: The sun here is relentless! UV radiation is the enemy of preservation! I am staying under this umbrella until we leave.
Arden.Location.Town: The town square is charming, but the statue of Mayor Lewis... the casting is cheap. It will rust in ten years.
Arden.Location.BusStop: I took this bus when I first arrived here. I carried three crates of books and a broken heart. The books survived.
Arden.Date.Summer2: The humidity is rising. I can feel the pages of my books swelling. I must check the dehumidifiers.
Arden.Season.Summer: I despise Summer. Heat expands metal. Sunlight bleaches fabric. It is a season of destruction.
Arden.Gift.Love: Wonderful. The workmanship... the filigree is thinner than a hair. Where did you find this?
Arden.Gift.Like: A good choice. Do not leave it in direct sunlight.
Arden.Gift.Dislike: Look with your eyes. If you break it, you will not be able to pay for it.
Arden.Gift.Hate: Please... get away from me. You smell of refuse and decay. Do not sullly the archives.
Roxy.Introduction: Welcome to BuyCo... yeah, yeah, I see you. Look, order something or move. My manager is watching the cameras.
Roxy.Day.Mon: The fryer is broken. The shake machine is broken. I'm broken. Typical Monday.
Roxy.Day.Tue: You know what's in the 'Mystery Meat' nuggets? Me neither. And I cook them. Eat at your own risk.
Roxy.Day.Wed: I tried to call in sick. Manager said I needed a doctor's note. Like I can afford a doctor on this wage.
Roxy.Day.Thu: If I hear this store playlist one more time... I swear, I'm gonna stab the speaker system with a fork.
Roxy.Day.Fri: Weekend rush coming up. Tourists buying bulk toilet paper and cheap soda. I hate people.
Roxy.Day.Sat: Don't talk to me. I'm in the zone. If I stop moving, I'll realize where I am and scream.
Roxy.Day.Sun: My only day off. I plan to sleep until noon and play my bass until the neighbors call the cops.
Roxy.Hearts4.Mon: You know, you're the only customer who doesn't treat me like a vending machine. It's... weird. But thanks.
Roxy.Hearts4.Fri: My band? Yeah, we're called 'Fiscal Cliff'. Or maybe 'The Dead Pixels'. We haven't decided. We mostly just argue in my garage.
Roxy.Hearts6.Wed: Why did you come here? To the valley? To escape? ...Yeah. Me too. Except I escaped *into* a retail nightmare.
Roxy.Hearts6.Sat: Sometimes I steal boxes of donuts from the back. Want one? They're stale, but they taste like rebellion.
Roxy.Hearts8.Mon: I wrote a song about you yesterday. It's fast. Loud. A little messy. ...Don't ask to hear it.
Roxy.Hearts8.Fri: I think I hate this job a little less when you're leaning on the counter. Don't let it go to your head.
Roxy.Lore.PepperPit: People think I go to Blaise's shop to buy gifts. No. I go there to sample 'Liquid Regret'. It burns so bad I literally forget I work at BuyCo for twenty minutes. It's cheaper than therapy.
Roxy.Lore.Jett: I had to ask Jett to solder my amp cable last week. They looked at it like it was alien technology, but they fixed it. Nice kid.
Roxy.Schedule.Work: Here is your order. Napkins are over there. Don't choke. Next!
Roxy.Schedule.Break: *Cough*... Man, don't tell anyone I'm back here. I just need five minutes of silence.
Roxy.Schedule.PepperPit: Don't talk to me. I just ate a ghost pepper. My face is numb, my eyes are watering, and I think I can see through time. This is awesome.
Roxy.Schedule.Jett: I blew another fuse on my amp. Jett's the only one who knows how to fix it without lecturing me about 'proper voltage maintenance'.
Roxy.Schedule.BusySaturday: Don't. Just... don't. It's Saturday. The customers are feral. I am holding onto my sanity by a thread.
Roxy.Schedule.BassPractice: ONE! TWO! THREE! FOUR! ...Ugh. Missed the beat. Again.
Roxy.Schedule.Writing: I come out here because the river is loud. It drowns out the noise in my head so I can think of a rhyme for 'gasoline'.
Roxy.Schedule.GreenRain: Nope. Not going out there. The moss looks like it wants to eat my shoes. I'm staying inside and watching old horror movies.
Roxy.Skill.Cooking: Wait, you bake your own bread? Like... with flour? Weird flex, farmer. But... can I try some?
Roxy.Engagement.Refusal: Whoa! Is that... a Mermaid's Pendant? Ideally, this is where I scream and cry and we plan a wedding. But... no. I can't do the white dress. I can't do the ceremony.$s#$b#But... I hate my apartment. And I... kinda don't hate you. So how about this: I move in. We're partners. Roommates with benefits. We figure it out. Deal?$l
Roxy.Dating.General: So... we're a thing now? Cool. Just don't expect me to start writing poetry.
Roxy.Dating.Work: Hey. I'd kiss you, but I smell like deep-fryer grease and despair. Raincheck?
Roxy.Marriage.Mon: I'm heading to the Food Court. Don't wait up. I might smell like onions when I get back.
Roxy.Marriage.Fri: Living here is... quiet. It's weird. No sirens. No neighbors screaming. I could get used to this.
Roxy.Event.12Heart.2: When I moved in, I told you I wasn't ready for the whole 'Marriage' label. I thought it was just... paperwork. A trap.
Roxy.Event.12Heart.3: But... waking up here? Being with you? It doesn't feel like a trap. It feels like... freedom.
Roxy.Event.12Heart.4: So... if you still want to do it... the real way... I'm down. Let's be married. For real this time.
Roxy.Gift.Love: Pizza?! Yes! Oh my god, you are a lifesaver. I was starving.$h
Roxy.Gift.Hate: Ew. What is this? Health food? Get it away from me.$a
Roxy.Event.2Heart.1: Can't a girl write a grocery list in peace? Get lost, farmer.
Roxy.Event.2Heart.A2: It looked like you were slacking off.
Roxy.Event.2Heart.R1: Poetry? Gross. No. ...It's a song. Maybe. Don't tell anyone.
Roxy.Event.2Heart.R2: I'm on break! God, you sound like my manager.
Roxy.Event.4Heart.1: Okay, one more time! Jett, did you fix the fuzz on the amp?
Roxy.Event.4Heart.2: I re-routed the capacitor. The 'fuzz' was actually a fire hazard. It's safe now.
Roxy.Event.4Heart.3: Safe is boring! I need crunch! Ugh. Fine. From the top!
Roxy.Event.4Heart.4: Oh. You're here. ...Enjoying the noise pollution?
Roxy.Event.8Heart.2: I was ready to quit. Jett said the amp was fried, and I figured... maybe it was a sign. A sign to give up.
Roxy.Event.8Heart.A2: Giving up is for BuyCo employees. You're a rockstar.
Roxy.Event.8Heart.R1: My noise, huh? ...Yeah. Maybe it does. Thanks, @.$h
Roxy.Event.8Heart.R2: Heh. You're right. I'm not letting this place bury me.
Roxy.Event.10Heart.1: Hey. Thanks for coming. There's like... five people here. But you're here. That counts.
Roxy.Event.10Heart.2: This song... it's about finding something real in a plastic world. It's for you.
Roxy.Event.10Heart.3: That felt... good. Really good. Maybe I can do this.
Roxy.Marriage.Init: Hey. Coffee's on. I didn't burn it this time.$h#$b#You know, waking up without a manager screaming at me is... weird. Good weird.
Roxy.Marriage.Morning: I was watching the sunrise. Did you know the sky turns purple before it turns orange? I never saw that when I was working the opening shift.
Roxy.Marriage.Afternoon: I wrote three new verses today. The farm is quiet. It helps.
Roxy.Marriage.Evening: Come sit with me. I don't want to talk. I just want to exist near you.
Roxy.Marriage.Tue: I'm thinking of planting something. Something spiky. Like a cactus. Or roses. What do you think?
Roxy.Marriage.Wed: I saw Clark at the store today. He asked why I wasn't in uniform. I laughed in his face. It felt amazing.$h
Roxy.Marriage.Thu: Jett says the band misses me practicing in the garage. I told them the acoustics in the farmhouse are better. Sorry if I'm loud.
Roxy.Marriage.Sat: Saturdays used to be hell. Now look at us. Just... chilling. Is this legal?
Roxy.Marriage.Sun: Let's stay in bed. The crops can wait. The cows can wait. I can't wait.
Roxy.Marriage.Patio: The air out here is clean. No fryer grease. Just... pine and dirt. I like it.
Roxy.Marriage.Rainy: Rain on the roof beats the BuyCo playlist any day. Let's stay inside and make noise.
Roxy.Marriage.Romance: You saved me, you know. I wasn't drowning, but I was... sinking. Thanks for pulling me out.$l
Roxy.Marriage.Love: I love you. Yeah, yeah, don't make a face. I said it. Deal with it.$l
Roxy.Marriage.Pregnant: So... we're doing this? A tiny human? Okay. We can do this. It's gonna be punk rock.$h
Roxy.Marriage.Baby: The kid is loud. Like... distortion pedal loud. I'm so proud.$h
Roxy.Schedule.JettMarried: I come by to check on Jett. They pretend they don't miss me, but I saw them talking to a toaster earlier. They need social interaction.
Roxy.Schedule.Gig: I'm nervous. I'm always nervous before a set. But then I see you in the crowd, and it's okay.
Roxy.Schedule.SmokeBreak: Five minutes. I just need five minutes without hearing 'Unexpected Item in Bagging Area'.
Roxy.Schedule.Crash: Too... tired... to walk... home. Jett's couch... is fine. Zzz.
Cassidy.Roxy_Booking: Oh, hey @! We're looking for live music for Friday nights. The radio is broken again.$b#$q 9001 Roxy_Gig_Q#Do you know anyone?#$r 9001 0 Roxy_Gig_Yes#Roxy has a band. They're amazing.#$r 9001 0 Roxy_Gig_No#No idea. Sorry.
Cassidy.Roxy_Gig_Yes: Roxy? From BuyCo? No way! She always looks so... angry. But if you say she's good, I trust you!$h#$b#Tell her she's booked for Friday. I'll clear the stage!
Cassidy.Dialogue.Intro: Welcome to Timberline Falls! I'm Cassidy! I run the floor at the Drum!$h#$b#If you need anything—coffee, biscuits, a map, emotional support, someone to move heavy rocks—just ask! I can do it! I promise!
Cassidy.Work.Generic: Order up! I memorized the whole ticket! No need to write it down! Brain is a steel trap! ...Wait, was that table 4 or 5?
Cassidy.Work.Coffee: Refill? You got it! I'm on my sixth cup. My hands aren't shaking, they're vibrating with enthusiasm!
Cassidy.Work.Rush: I love the lunch rush! It's like a puzzle you have to solve before everyone gets hangry! It's fun! I'm having fun!
Cassidy.Work.Fake: Smile's on! Apron's on! ...Oh, it's just you. Hey, Farmer. Sorry, I can't turn the 'Customer Service Voice' off. It's stuck.
Cassidy.Spring.Mon: New week! I'm going to reorganize the spice rack alphabetically, then by color, then by smell! It keeps me busy!
Cassidy.Spring.Tue: Dr. Thorne said I need to 'slow down'. I told him I'll slow down when the rent pays itself! Haha! ...He didn't laugh.
Cassidy.Spring.Wed: I saw Jett working on an engine. They looked so focused. It must be nice to fix things with a wrench. People are harder to fix.
Cassidy.Spring.Thu: If I stop moving, the tiredness catches up. So the strategy is: never stop moving! Constant velocity!
Cassidy.Spring.Fri: Tourist season! They treat me like a vending machine, but that's okay! Vending machines are useful! Everyone likes vending machines!
Cassidy.Spring.Sat: I scrubbed the floors last night until 2 AM. Look how shiny they are! You can see the bags under my eyes in the reflection!
Cassidy.Spring.Sun: Sunday is a day of rest? Who came up with that? Sunday is 'Pre-Monday Prep Day'! Gotta get ahead!
Cassidy.Summer.Mon: It's so hot! But the heat keeps the customers thirsty, so business is booming! I haven't sat down in six hours!
Cassidy.Summer.Tue: I think I forgot to eat yesterday. Whoops! Efficiency error! I'll just have an extra biscuit today.
Cassidy.Summer.Wed: I tried to help Vance organize his ammo crates. He yelled at me to 'evacuate the sector'. He's so funny.
Cassidy.Summer.Thu: My feet are numb. That's good, right? If they're numb, they don't hurt! Modern solutions!
Cassidy.Summer.Fri: I'm fine! Everything is fine! The ice machine broke but I fixed it with a spoon and pure willpower!
Cassidy.Summer.Sat: People keep asking if I'm okay. Why does everyone ask that? Do I look not okay? I'm smiling! See? Big smile!
Cassidy.Summer.Sun: I sat on my couch for five minutes and I felt... guilty. Like I was stealing time. Is that normal?
Cassidy.Fall.Mon: The leaves are falling. They just let go and hit the ground. Must be nice to just... let go.
Cassidy.Fall.Tue: I caught a cold. It's fine. I just won't breathe on the food. I can hold my breath while I serve! It's a fun game!
Cassidy.Fall.Wed: I dropped a plate today. Just one plate. But I cried in the walk-in freezer for ten minutes. Weird, right?
Cassidy.Fall.Thu: The days are getting shorter. Less time to get things done. I have to work faster to beat the sun.
Cassidy.Fall.Fri: I wish I was a bear. Hibernation sounds amazing. Just sleep for months and nobody calls you lazy.
Cassidy.Fall.Sat: I'm still useful, right? Even if I'm a little slower today? I'm still worth the paycheck?
Cassidy.Fall.Sun: I made a list of things I did today. Only ten things. I need to do better tomorrow.
Cassidy.Winter.Mon: It's dark. It's cold. But the Drum is warm! I'll just stay here. If I go home, I might not come back.
Cassidy.Winter.Tue: My back hurts. Dr. Thorne says it's 'stress fractures'. I say it's 'character building'.
Cassidy.Winter.Wed: No customers today. The silence is loud. If I'm not serving anyone... what am I doing here?
Cassidy.Winter.Thu: I'm reading a book on 'Relaxation'. It's stressing me out. There are so many rules for relaxing!
Cassidy.Winter.Fri: Can you check my forehead? Do I feel warm? ...No, don't tell me. If I have a fever, I have to go home. Lie to me.
Cassidy.Winter.Sat: I fell asleep standing up. I dreamt I was a Roomba. Efficient. Tireless.
Cassidy.Winter.Sun: I think... I think I need a break. But I can't take one. If I stop, everything falls apart.
Cassidy.Spring.Mon4: You know... sometimes I worry that if I stop being 'Cassidy the Waitress', there's no one underneath.
Cassidy.Summer.Fri4: My mom used to say, 'Idle hands are the devil's playthings.' I think I took that too literally.
Cassidy.Winter.Sun4: I tried to take a nap. I just stared at the ceiling and made a grocery list. How do you do it? How do you turn your brain off?
Cassidy.Spring.Mon8: I took a walk today. Without a destination. I didn't deliver anything. I didn't fix anything. I just walked. It felt... rebellious.
Cassidy.Winter.Fri8: Thank you for listening to me. Usually, I'm the one listening. It feels nice to be the one talking for once.
Cassidy.Winter.Sun8: I made you a coffee. Decaf. Sit down. Drink it. ...Please? I need to see someone relaxing. Maybe I'll learn by osmosis.
Cassidy.Schedule.Morning_Prep: Tables wiped! Sugar filled! Napkins stacked! Let's go, let's go!
Cassidy.Schedule.Trip_Save: Whoops! Almost dropped it! ...I'm okay! No shattered glass today!
Cassidy.Schedule.Clinic_Tired: I'm just here for vitamins, Doc! I don't need a lecture on 'burnout'. Just give me the B12!
Cassidy.Schedule.PostClinic_Work: See? I'm back! Doctor's orders were 'go home', but he doesn't sign my checks!
Cassidy.Schedule.Jett_Work: Jett! Hydrate! You're looking rusty! ...That was a machine joke. Did you like it?
Cassidy.Schedule.Vance_Help: Vance! These grenades aren't color-coordinated! Let me fix that! ...Okay, putting the grenade down!
Cassidy.Schedule.Late_Start: I overslept! 8 AM! I've wasted the whole morning! I'm the worst!
Cassidy.Schedule.Helping_BuyCo: Clark, this aisle is a disaster! I'm organizing the soup cans! Don't thank me!
Cassidy.Schedule.PepperPit_Anxiety: Okay. I'm socializing. Look at me holding this drink. I look totally relaxed. ...Am I doing it right?
Cassidy.Schedule.Winter_Exhaustion: I just need to lean on the counter for a second. Just... one second. Don't tell the boss.
Cassidy.Schedule.Home_Chores: Laundry. Dishes. Dusting. If the apartment is clean, my brain is clean. That's how it works.
Cassidy.Quest.Active: That berry... the EmberBerry? I remember eating it and feeling... real. Not useful. Not busy. Just... real.
